intro.title: Project Overview
intro.subtitle: Development Timeline Overview
intro.paragraph1: TIIP Mold Industry Advanced Manufacturing System development timeline, documenting the complete development process from August 2024 to July 2025. Covering core functional modules including material management, quality assurance system, intelligent cost analysis, business quotation system, machine maintenance, WiseScheduling intelligent scheduling, and manufacturing monitoring center.
intro.paragraph2: The development process evolved from basic CRUD functionality to complex scheduling visualization, real-time monitoring, and API integration. Utilizing modern technology stack such as React ecosystem, Material-UI, Redux Toolkit, and Zod validation, with emphasis on code quality, component reusability, and system maintainability, achieving industrial-grade frontend application development standards.
